description: 生产 live evidence 操作员执行包契约。该执行包聚合 closure work queue、proof-ref gate、category runbooks、0123 live proof gate 和 0124 production live delivery evidence bundle，输出不含敏感值的命令顺序、环境变量名、脱敏证据模板和最终 gate 链，供真实凭证到位时执行。

executionPolicy.packetGate: blocked until real operator executes live commands and generated redacted proof-ref/live evidence bundles pass 0123/0124 gates.
executionPolicy.noNetwork: This generator must not execute production API, HF Space, Telegram Bot, Postgres webhook or multi-surface live commands.
executionPolicy.redaction: Output may contain environment variable names and placeholder artifact paths only; it must not contain environment variable assignments, raw endpoint URLs, token values, DSNs, webhook secrets, chat ids, report bodies or production logs.
executionPolicy.sourceBinding: Output must bind to work queue sha256, proof-ref gate sha256, category runbooks sha256, 0123 contract sha256, 0124 contract sha256 and current commit.

privacyBoundary: Execution packet output may contain work item ids、owner、category、runbook id、required environment variable names、placeholder output paths、artifact hash instructions、command templates and source hashes; it must not contain real URL、token、secret、DSN、webhook secret、chat id、external account、production log、report body or user input.
nonClaims: Does not execute production live checks.
Does not prove production API/HF/Bot/webhook live has passed.
Does not create accepted proof refs by itself.
Does not mean FateCat is 100% production infrastructure.
